title: Choose the landing-page composition
question: Which first-view structure feels most like SpecPasa? The product, palette, screenshots, and claims stay fixed; this locks the page’s visual argument.

options.label: Freeze Gate Control Room
options.thesis: Make the IDEA → PRD → ERD → TASKS freeze gates the first thing people understand, with the active product workspace as immediate proof.
options.palette: Cool paper, white sheets, dark ink, mint gates
options.materials: Enterprise workbench, crisp rules, tactile status rails
options.viewport: Lifecycle rail above a large PRD workspace
options.risk: Slightly denser first viewport, but fastest product comprehension

options.label: Version Ledger
options.thesis: Lead with review history, version snapshots, and AI provenance so enterprise trust becomes the primary reason to keep reading.
options.palette: Cool paper, white sheets, dark ink, mint provenance
options.materials: Ledger rows, review annotations, precise metadata
options.viewport: Version rail beside selected content and review threads
options.risk: Strong governance story; the end-to-end workflow lands second

options.label: Lifecycle Runway
options.thesis: Turn the complete idea-to-implementation journey into one sweeping runway, with the active PRD workspace embedded directly in the flow.
options.palette: Cool paper, white sheets, dark ink, mint path
options.materials: Sequenced stations, connecting rails, generous whitespace
options.viewport: Large linear lifecycle with an embedded product panel
options.risk: Most inviting and spacious; individual governance details appear later
